property_summary: For any caller address, when they call airDrop the reference contract always increases their tokenBalance by 20 (from 0 to 20 because hasNoBalance requires zero) — the mutant that compares to the wrong string prevents the supportsToken check from passing for a legitimate Bank contract and therefore can make airDrop not execute, breaking the rule for some caller.
change_summary: Change supportsToken to compare to a different string, making the modifier fail for the legitimate Bank and preventing airDrop from executing.
